title: Base change transports an arbitrary direct-image tensor pairing
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y^{\prime}\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with fibre product projections $f^{\prime},g_X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $R=Rf_*$, $R^{\prime}=Rf^{\prime}_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], $L=Lg^*$, $L_X=Lg_X^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and $\beta:LR\to R^{\prime}L_X$ for the canonical mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Use the normalized pullback tensorators $\tau$ [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso] and the counit-defined pairing $q$ [def-sc-mixed-direct-image-tensor-pairing]. For all $A,B,C$ in the sheaf derived category of $X$ [def-pc-derived-category] and every $a:A\otimes B\to C$, $(\beta_A\otimes\beta_B);q_{f^{\prime}}(L_XA,L_XB);R^{\prime}(\tau_{g_X}^{-1};L_Xa)=\tau_g^{-1};L(q_f(A,B);Ra);\beta_C$. No base-change map is assumed invertible and no internal Hom is used.

proof.text: Apply the identity-pairing coherence to A and B. Its inlined counit pairing is definitionally mixedDirectImageTensorPairing.
Postcompose by Rf′_*(LgX*a). Rewrite functoriality and associativity and use the proved naturality of the canonical base-change mate.

mathlib_searches.query: base change natural transformation preserves the direct image tensor pairing as mate of monoidal pullback
The mate of a monoidal natural transformation commutes with the lax monoidal tensor pairing on right adjoints
mathlib_searches.results: Found Adjunction.rightAdjointLaxMonoidal_μ and counit compatibility in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Functor, plus mateEquiv in Adjunction.Mates. CanonicalPullbackTensorMonoidalRealization supplies monoidal structures for the fixed pullback tensorators, but no existing declaration says the pinned pullback-composition comparisons are monoidal or directly gives the required base-change pairing identity.

No Mathlib hits. Repository and blueprint search finds no direct-image tensor pairing base-change declaration. Existing InternalHomBaseChangeExchange has a different tensorator and an extra module-localization assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedTensorPairing_baseChange
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (A B C : schemeDerivedCategory X) (a : A ⊗ B ⟶ C) :
    (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition A ⊗ₘ
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition B) ≫
      mixedDirectImageTensorPairing (pullback.snd f g)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj A)
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj B) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso (pullback.fst f g)).inv.app (A, B) ≫
          (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).map a) =
    (mixedHomTensorPullbackIso g).inv.app
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj B) ≫
      (derivedPullback g).map
        (mixedDirectImageTensorPairing f A B ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map a) ≫
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition C
